pli-tv-pvr2.12:1.1: kāyasaṃsaggaṃ sādiyanapaccayā āpattiyo sattannaṃ āpattikkhandhānaṃ katīhi . . .
pli-tv-pvr2.12:1.3: siyā pārājikāpattikkhandhena siyā saṃghādisesāpattikkhandena siyā thullaccayāpattikkhandhena siyā pācittiyāpattikkhandhena siyā dukkaṭāpattikkhandhena. --la--.
pli-tv-pvr2.12:2.3: siyā pāṭidesaniyāpattikkhandhena siyā dukkaṭāpattikkhandhena. saṃgahavāraṃ niṭṭhitaṃ catutthaṃ. ||12||
